parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ case_id: $json.review_case.case_id, potential_match_score: $json.potential_match_score, band: $json.band, face_similarity: $json.review_case.face_similarity, status: "awaiting_human_review", notice: $json.notice, face_notice: $json.face_notice, review_notice: $json.review_notice }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: "Potential match for review: " + $json.review_case.case_id + " (" + $json.potential_match_score + "/100). HUMAN VERIFICATION REQUIRED.", review_case: $json.review_case }) }}

meta.notice: Compares two humanitarian records and produces a potential match score for human review. It never establishes identity. Built and tested against synthetic data only.
meta.requires: An Anthropic credential on the two Claude nodes. Everything else runs without credentials.
